section: Policy Matches but Server Never Responds / TCP Connects but TLS Fails
content:
# Policy Matches but Server Never Responds / TCP Connects but TLS Fails

Likely areas:

- Server offline
- Host firewall
- Wrong service port
- Wrong gateway
- Return routing

Likely areas:

- Certificate
- TLS configuration
- Reverse proxy
- Application
- SNI or hostname behavior

Do not change firewall policy to fix an application-layer TLS problem.

---
